values.meaning: additional physical damage on basic attacks/abilities

mechanics.claim: This effect cannot occur on the same target for a period of time.
mechanics.quote: This effect cannot occur on the same target more than once every few seconds.

mechanics.claim: Gathering an Element with Terrashape resets Royal Privilege's per-target cooldown for enemies hit with a different or no Element.
mechanics.quote: Gathering an {{as|Element|buzzword}} with ''{{ai|Terrashape|Qiyana}}'' resets ''Royal Privilege's'' per-target {{sti|cooldown}} for enemies affected by ''Royal Privilege'' using a different {{as|Element|buzzword}} (or no {{as|Element|buzzword}}).

mechanics.claim: The trigger from a basic attack can be blocked, negating the additional damage and the on-target cooldown.
mechanics.quote: ''Royal Privilege's'' trigger from a basic attack can be {{tip|blocked}} (additional damage is negated and the on-target cooldown does not apply).

mechanics.claim: Royal Privilege is applied in a separate damage instance from Qiyana's basic attacks and abilities, causing some on-hit/on-damage effects to trigger twice.
mechanics.quote: ''Royal Privilege'' is applied in a separate damage instance from '''Qiyana's''' basic attacks and abilities.

mechanics.claim: The effect does not trigger against structures nor wards.
mechanics.quote: The effect will not trigger against {{tip|structures}} nor {{tip|wards}}.
